```python
class CallTimeout(Exception): pass
def _handler(signum, frame): raise CallTimeout(...)
@contextmanager
def time_limit(seconds):
    old=signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,_handler); signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL,seconds)
    try: yield
    finally: signal.setitimer(...,0); signal.signal(SIGALRM, old)
```

```
def third_friday(year, month):
    d = date(year, month, 1)
    fridays = [d + timedelta(days=i) for i in range(31) if (d+...).month==month and weekday==4]
    return fridays[2]
```

```
    if nominal in csi_dates:
```

```
def resolve_expiry_dates(csi: pd.DataFrame, nominal_dates: set[date]) -> tuple[dict[date,date], dict]:
    csi_dates = sorted(csi["date"])
    csi_set = set(csi_dates)
    if not csi_dates:
        return {nominal: nominal for nominal in nominal_dates}, {"calendar_start":None,...,"rolled":[],"unverified_future":sorted(...), "verified":[]}
    last = csi_dates[-1]
    resolved={}
    rolled=[]; verified=[]; future=[]
    for nominal in sorted(nominal_dates):
        if nominal > last:
            resolved[nominal]=nominal; future.append(nominal.isoformat())
        elif nominal in csi_set:
            resolved[nominal]=nominal; verified.append(nominal.isoformat())
        else:
            # nominal <= last but not trading -> next trading > nominal
            next_day = next((d for d in csi_dates if d > nominal), None)
            if next_day is None:
                resolved[nominal]=nominal; future.append(nominal.isoformat())
            else:
                resolved[nominal]=next_day; rolled.append({"nominal":..., "expiry":..., "reason":"holiday_roll"})
    ...
```

`uv.toml` pins uv's cache to `.uv-cache/`; `.cache/` and `.uv-cache/` are gitignored so tool caches stay inside the repository.

## Layout

- `data/raw/` — downloaded source snapshots (gitignored)
- `data/clean/` — committed cleaned snapshots for offline grading
- `code/` — analysis and model scripts
- `results/` — metrics and figures, one directory per approach

## Reproducibility

All stochastic steps are seeded (`--seed 42` by default). Every reported number must come from a `results/approachN/<dataset>/metrics.json`.

```
def surface_frames(fits: dict, stage: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []

        params = fit[stage]["params"]
        w = svi_w(SURFACE_K, params)
        with np.errstate(invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
            iv = np.sqrt(w / fit["T"])
        rows.append(pd.DataFrame({
            "date": fit["date"],
            "expiry": fit["expiry"],
```

```
def build_fit_slices(fits: dict, sample_dates: list[str], out_path: Path) -> None:
    dates = [date for date in sample_dates if any(fit["date"] == date for fit in fits.values())]
    if not dates:
        dates = sorted({fit["date"] for fit in fits.values()})[:6]
    max_expiries = max(len({fit["expiry"] for fit in fits.values() if fit["date"] == date}) for date in dates)
    fig = make_subplots(
        rows=len(dates),
        cols=max_expiries,
        subplot_titles=[f"{date} exp {i + 1}" for date in dates for i in range(max_expiries)],
        vertical_spacing=0.035,
        horizontal_spacing=0.03,
    )
    for row_idx, date in enumerate(dates, start=1):
        items = sorted([fit for fit in fits.values() if fit["date"] == date], key=lambda item: item["T"])
        for col_idx, fit in enumerate(items, start=1):
            line_k = np.round(np.arange(-0.20, 0.20 + 0.005, 0.01), 10)
            raw_w = svi_w(line_k, fit["raw"]["params"])
            rep_w = svi_w(line_k, fit["repaired"]["params"])
            with np.errstate(invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
                raw_iv = np.sqrt(raw_w / fit["T"])
                rep_iv = np.sqrt(rep_w / fit["T"])
            fig.add_trace(
                go.Scatter(x=fit["k"], y=fit["iv"], mode="markers", name="OTM quotes", marker=dict(size=4, color="#1f77b4"), showlegend=(row_idx == 1 and col_idx == 1)),
                row=row_idx,
                col=col_idx,
            )
            fig.add_trace(
                go.Scatter(x=line_k, y=raw_iv, mode="lines", name="raw SVI", line=dict(color="#ff7f0e", width=1.2), showlegend=(row_idx == 1 and col_idx == 1)),
                row=row_idx,
                col=col_idx,
            )
            fig.add_trace(
                go.Scatter(x=line_k, y=rep_iv, mode="lines", name="repaired SVI", line=dict(color="#2ca02c", width=1.2, dash="dot"), showlegend=(row_idx == 1 and col_idx == 1)),
                row=row_idx,
                col=col_idx,
            )
            fig.update_xaxes(title_text="k", row=row_idx, col=col_idx)
            fig.update_yaxes(title_text="IV", row=row_idx, col=col_idx)
    fig.update_layout(height=max(420, 300 * len(dates)), width=1800, title="Fitted SVI slices on sample dates")
    fig.write_html(out_path, include_plotlyjs=True)


def build_surface(fits: dict, out_path: Path) -> None:
    by_date: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for fit in fits.values():
        by_date.setdefault(fit["date"], []).append(fit)
    dates = sorted(by_date)
    frames = []
    for date in dates:
        items = sorted(by_date[date], key=lambda item: item["T"])
        Ts = np.array([item["T"] for item in items])
        z = []
        for item in items:
            w = svi_w(SURFACE_K, item["repaired"]["params"])
            with np.errstate(invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
                z.append(np.sqrt(w / item["T"]))
        frames.append(go.Frame(
            name=date,
            data=[go.Surface(
                x=SURFACE_K,
                y=Ts,
                z=np.vstack(z),
                colorscale="Viridis",
                colorbar=dict(title="IV"),
                name=date,
            )],
        ))
    first_items = sorted(by_date[dates[0]], key=lambda item: item["T"])
    first_T = np.array([item["T"] for item in first_items])
    first_z = []
    for item in first_items:
        w = svi_w(SURFACE_K, item["repaired"]["params"])
        with np.errstate(invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
            first_z.append(np.sqrt(w / item["T"]))
    fig = go.Figure(
        data=[go.Surface(x=SURFACE_K, y=first_T, z=np.vstack(first_z), colorscale="Viridis", colorbar=dict(title="IV"))],
        frames=frames,
    )
    steps = [dict(method="animate", args=[[date], dict(mode="immediate", frame=dict(duration=0, redraw=True), transition=dict(duration=0))], label=date) for date in dates]
    fig.update_layout(
        title="SVI implied-volatility surface (repaired; use slider to change date)",
        scene=dict(xaxis_title="k = ln(K/F)", yaxis_title="T (years)", zaxis_title="IV"),
        sliders=[dict(active=0, currentvalue=dict(prefix="Date: "), steps=steps)],
        height=850,
    )
    fig.write_html(out_path, include_plotlyjs=True)

    arr = arr[np.isfinite(arr)]
```

```
def monthly_sample_table(calibration: pd.DataFrame, sample_months: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
    rows = []
    for month in sample_months:
        subset = calibration[calibration.month == month]
        if subset.empty:
            continue
        rows.append({
            "month": month,
            "dates": int(len(subset)),
            "fits": int(subset.n_fits.sum()),
            "skipped": int(subset.n_skipped.sum()),
            "quotes_liquid": int(subset.quotes_liquid.sum()),
            "median_q": float(subset.median_q.median()) if subset.median_q.notna().any() else float("nan"),
            "butterfly_raw": int(subset.butterfly_raw.sum()),
            "butterfly_repaired": int(subset.butterfly_repaired.sum()),
            "calendar_raw": int(subset.calendar_raw.sum()),
            "calendar_repaired": int(subset.calendar_repaired.sum()),
            "repricing_median_raw": float(subset.repricing_median_raw.median()) if subset.repricing_median_raw.notna().any() else float("nan"),
            "repricing_median_repaired": float(subset.repricing_median_repaired.median()) if subset.repricing_median_repaired.notna().any() else float("nan"),
        })
    return rows
```

```
def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict:
    console = Console(width=220)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    np.random.seed(args.seed)
    root = ROOT.resolve()
    out_resolved = args.out_dir.resolve()
    if out_resolved != root and root not in out_resolved.parents:
        raise ValueError(f"output directory must stay inside {root}: {out_resolved}")
    args.out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    console.print("[bold]Loading and verifying data[/bold]")
    options, shibor, metadata = load_data(args.options, args.shibor, args.metadata)
    input_hashes = {
        "options_sha256": sha256_file(args.options),
        "shibor_sha256": sha256_file(args.shibor),
    }
    console.print(f"  options rows={len(options):,} dates={options.date.nunique()} expiries={options.expiry.nunique()}")
    console.print(f"  shibor rows={len(shibor):,} range={shibor.date.min().date()}..{shibor.date.max().date()}")

    console.print("[bold]Estimating forwards from put-call parity[/bold]")
    forwards, parity = estimate_forwards(options, shibor, args.price_col)
    data, filter_counts = apply_filters(options, forwards, args)
    console.print(f"  date-expiry pairs={len(forwards)} | quotes liquid={filter_counts['quotes_liquid']:,}/{filter_counts['quotes_total']:,}")

    console.print("[bold]Inverting implied volatilities[/bold]")
    iv, divergence, iv_stats = compute_implied_vols(data[data.liquid])
    console.print(f"  IV ok={iv_stats['ok_quotes']:,}/{iv_stats['attempted_quotes']:,} | C-P gap median={iv_stats['gap_median']:.3g} p95|gap|={iv_stats['gap_p95_abs']:.3g}")

    console.print("[bold]Fitting raw SVI and repairing violations[/bold]")
    fit_start = time.perf_counter()
    fits, svi_params, fit_history = make_fits(forwards, data, iv, args.min_strikes)
```

```
def load_cffex_futures(raw_dir: Path) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict]:
    required = {"合约代码", "今收盘", "今结算"}
    rows = []
    errors = []
    files = sorted(raw_dir.glob("*.csv"))
    for path in files:
        date_text = path.stem.split("_")[0]
        try:
            file_date = pd.Timestamp(date_text)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            errors.append({"file": path.name, "error": "unparseable_date"})
            continue
        try:
            frame = pd.read_csv(path, encoding="utf-8-sig")
        except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, pd.errors.ParserError) as exc:
            errors.append({"file": path.name, "error": type(exc).__name__})
            continue
        if not required.issubset(frame.columns):
            errors.append({"file": path.name, "error": "missing_columns"})
            continue
        for code_raw, close_raw, settle_raw in frame[["合约代码", "今收盘", "今结算"]].itertuples(index=False, name=None):
            code = str(code_raw).strip()
            if len(code) != 6 or not code.startswith("IF") or not code[2:].isdigit():
                continue
            yy = int(code[2:4])
            mm = int(code[4:6])
            if not 1 <= mm <= 12:
                continue
            close = pd.to_numeric(close_raw, errors="coerce")
            settle = pd.to_numeric(settle_raw, errors="coerce")
            rows.append({
                "date": file_date,
                "contract": code,
                "fut_expiry_month": f"{2000 + yy:04d}-{mm:02d}",
                "if_close": float(close) if pd.notna(close) else np.nan,
                "if_settle": float(settle) if pd.notna(settle) else np.nan,
            })
    frame = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if frame.empty:
        return frame, {"files": len(files), "parsed_files": 0, "if_rows": 0, "errors": errors}
    frame = frame.drop_duplicates(["date", "contract"]).sort_values(["date", "contract"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    parsed_files = frame.date.nunique()
    stats = {
        "files": int(len(files)),
        "parsed_files": int(parsed_files),
        "if_rows": int(len(frame)),
        "errors": errors,
    }
    return frame, stats


def forward_check(forwards: pd.DataFrame, futures: pd.DataFrame, source_stats: dict) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict]:
    obs = forwards[["date", "expiry", "T", "days", "r", "DF", "S0", "F", "q"]].copy()
    obs["month"] = obs.date.dt.strftime("%Y-%m")
    obs["expiry_month"] = obs.expiry.dt.strftime("%Y-%m")
    obs["tenor_bucket"] = obs.days.map(tenor_bucket)
    if futures.empty:
        obs["if_close"] = np.nan
        obs["if_settle"] = np.nan
        obs["contract"] = None
    else:
        obs = obs.merge(
            futures[["date", "fut_expiry_month", "contract", "if_close", "if_settle"]],
            left_on=["date", "expiry_month"],
            right_on=["date", "fut_expiry_month"],
            how="left",
        ).drop(columns=["fut_expiry_month"])
    obs["if_rel_settle"] = (obs.F / obs.if_settle - 1.0).abs()
    obs["if_rel_close"] = (obs.F / obs.if_close - 1.0).abs()
    obs["if_basis_settle"] = np.where(
        (obs.if_settle > 0) & np.isfinite(obs.if_settle),
        obs.r - np.log(obs.if_settle / obs.S0) / obs["T"],
        np.nan,
    )
    obs["if_basis_close"] = np.where(
        (obs.if_close > 0) & np.isfinite(obs.if_close),
        obs.r - np.log(obs.if_close / obs.S0) / obs["T"],
        np.nan,
    )

    def dist(values: pd.Series) -> dict:
        arr = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
        arr = arr[np.isfinite(arr)]
        return {
            "n": int(arr.size),
            "median": float(np.median(arr)) if arr.size else float("nan"),
            "p95": float(np.quantile(arr, 0.95)) if arr.size else float("nan"),
            "max": float(np.max(arr)) if arr.size else float("nan"),
        }

    by_month = []
    for month, group in obs.groupby("month", sort=True):
        by_month.append({
            "month": month,
            "forwards": int(len(group)),
            "matched_settle": int(group.if_settle.notna().sum()),
            "matched_close": int(group.if_close.notna().sum()),
            "implied_q_median": float(group.q.median()),
            "if_basis_settle_median": float(group.if_basis_settle.median()) if group.if_basis_settle.notna().any() else float("nan"),
            "if_basis_close_median": float(group.if_basis_close.median()) if group.if_basis_close.notna().any() else float("nan"),
            "if_dev_settle": dist(group.if_rel_settle),
            "if_dev_close": dist(group.if_rel_close),
        })
    by_month_bucket = []
    for (month, bucket), group in obs.groupby(["month", "tenor_bucket"], sort=True):
        by_month_bucket.append({
            "month": month,
            "tenor_bucket": bucket,
            "forwards": int(len(group)),
            "matched_settle": int(group.if_settle.notna().sum()),
            "implied_q_median": float(group.q.median()),
            "if_basis_settle_median": float(group.if_basis_settle.median()) if group.if_basis_settle.notna().any() else float("nan"),
            "if_basis_close_median": float(group.if_basis_close.median()) if group.if_basis_close.notna().any() else float("nan"),
            "if_dev_settle_median": float(group.if_rel_settle.median()) if group.if_rel_settle.notna().any() else float("nan"),
            "if_dev_close_median": float(group.if_rel_close.median()) if group.if_rel_close.notna().any() else float("nan"),
        })
    by_bucket = []
    for bucket, group in obs.groupby("tenor_bucket", sort=True):
        by_bucket.append({
            "tenor_bucket": bucket,
            "forwards": int(len(group)),
            "matched_settle": int(group.if_settle.notna().sum()),
            "implied_q_median": float(group.q.median()),
            "if_basis_settle_median": float(group.if_basis_settle.median()) if group.if_basis_settle.notna().any() else float("nan"),
            "if_basis_close_median": float(group.if_basis_close.median()) if group.if_basis_close.notna().any() else float("nan"),
        })
    summary = {
        "source": source_stats,
        "forwards": int(len(obs)),
        "matched_settle": int(obs.if_settle.notna().sum()),
        "matched_close": int(obs.if_close.notna().sum()),
        "unmatched": int(len(obs) - obs.if_settle.notna().sum()),
        "if_dev_settle": dist(obs.if_rel_settle),
        "if_dev_close": dist(obs.if_rel_close),
        "implied_q_median": float(obs.q.median()),
        "if_basis_settle_median": float(obs.if_basis_settle.median()) if obs.if_basis_settle.notna().any() else float("nan"),
        "if_basis_close_median": float(obs.if_basis_close.median()) if obs.if_basis_close.notna().any() else float("nan"),
        "by_month": by_month,
        "by_month_bucket": by_month_bucket,
        "by_bucket": by_bucket,
        "note": "IF close/settle are the CFFEX fields 今收盘 and 今结算; matched by the IO expiry year-month. Basis is annualized r - ln(IF/S0)/T.",
    }
    return obs, summary
```

```
def matched_stats(group, suffix):
    basis_col=f"if_basis_{suffix}"
    matched=group[group[basis_col].notna()]
    diff=matched.q - matched[basis_col]
    return {
       "n": int(len(matched)),
       "implied_q_mean": float(matched.q.mean()) if len else nan,
       "implied_q_median": float(matched.q.median()) ...
       "if_basis_median": ...
       "q_minus_if_basis_mean": float(diff.mean()) ...
       "q_minus_if_basis_median": float(diff.median()) ...
    }
```

Design code patch:

```
def _matched_q_stats(group, basis_col):
    matched = group[group[basis_col].notna()].copy()
    if matched.empty:
        return {...}
    diff = matched.q - matched[basis_col]
    return {
      "n": int(len(matched)),
      "implied_q_mean": float(matched.q.mean()),
      "implied_q_median": float(matched.q.median()),
      "if_basis_mean": float(matched[basis_col].mean()),
      "if_basis_median": float(matched[basis_col].median()),
      "q_minus_if_basis_mean": float(diff.mean()),
      "q_minus_if_basis_median": float(diff.median()),
    }
```

Implementation details:

```
def _flat_params(params):
    return torch.cat([p.detach().reshape(-1) for p in params])
def _set_flat_params(params, x):
    offset=0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for p in params:
            n=p.numel()
            p.copy_(x[offset:offset+n].view_as(p))
            offset+=n
def _flat_grad(params):
    return torch.cat([p.grad.detach().reshape(-1) for p in params])
```
`x` is a tensor, no grad.

```
def evaluate_loss(model, loss_fn):
    for p in model.parameters(): p.grad=None
    loss = loss_fn()
    loss.backward()
    return float(loss.detach()), _flat_grad(list(model.parameters()))
```
`loss_fn` returns scalar tensor.

```
def lbfgs_torch(model, loss_fn, max_iter, max_evals, max_seconds):
    params=list(model.parameters())
    start=time.perf_counter()
    history=[]
    f,g = evaluate...
    best_f=f; best_state=...
    s_hist=[]; y_hist=[]; rho_hist=[]
    evals=1
    for it in range(max_iter):
        if time.perf_counter()-start>max_seconds or evals>=max_evals: break
        # compute direction
        q=g.clone()
        alphas=[]
        for s,y,rho in reversed(list(zip(s_hist,y_hist,rho_hist))):
            a=rho*torch.dot(s,q); q=q-a*y; alphas.append(a)
        if s_hist:
            sy=torch.dot(s_hist[-1],y_hist[-1]); yy=torch.dot(y_hist[-1],y_hist[-1])
            gamma=sy/yy if yy>0 else 1.0
        else: gamma=1.0
        r=gamma*q
        for (s,y,rho),a in zip(zip(s_hist,y_hist,rho_hist), reversed(alphas)):
            beta=rho*torch.dot(y,r); r=r+s*(a-beta)
        d=-r
        gd=torch.dot(g,d)
        if not torch.isfinite(gd) or gd>=0:
            d=-g; gd=-torch.dot(g,g)
        step=1.0
        accepted=False
        x0=_flat_params(params)
        for _ in range(20):
            if evals>=max_evals or time.perf_counter()-start>max_seconds: break
            x_new=x0+step*d
            _set_flat_params(params,x_new)
            f_new,g_new=evaluate_loss(...)
            evals+=1
            history.append(f_new)
            if f_new<best_f: best_f=f_new; best_state=copy
            if math.isfinite(f_new) and f_new <= f + 1e-4*step*gd:
                accepted=True; break
            step*=0.5
        if not accepted:
            # restore x0
            _set_flat_params(params,x0)
            # Need gradient at x0? g is from x0, yes.
            break
        s=x_new-x0; yv=g_new-g
        sy=torch.dot(s,yv)
        if sy>1e-12:
            s_hist.append(s); y_hist.append(yv); rho_hist.append(1.0/sy)
            if len(s_hist)>history_size: pop(0)
        f,g=f_new,g_new
        if torch.linalg.vector_norm(g)<tolerance_grad: break
    return best...
```

```
def neural_sigma_numpy(model: IVSurface, k: np.ndarray, T: np.ndarray, t_scale: float) -> np.ndarray:
    k_tensor = torch.tensor(np.asarray(k, dtype=float), dtype=DTYPE)
    T_tensor = torch.tensor(np.asarray(T, dtype=float), dtype=DTYPE)
    with torch.no_grad():
        sigma = model(k_tensor, T_tensor, t_scale)
    return sigma.detach().numpy()


def neural_repricing_errors(
    model: IVSurface,
    group: pd.DataFrame,
    t_scale: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, pd.DataFrame]:
    sigma = neural_sigma_numpy(model, group.k.to_numpy(dtype=float), group["T"].to_numpy(dtype=float), t_scale)
    model_prices = np.array([
        A1.bs_price(cp, float(F), float(K), float(T), float(DF), float(vol))
        for cp, F, K, T, DF, vol in zip(group.cp, group.F, group.K, group["T"], group.DF, sigma)
    ])
    market = group.price.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    valid = np.isfinite(model_prices) & np.isfinite(sigma) & (market > 0)
    rel = np.abs(model_prices[valid] - market[valid]) / market[valid]
    frame = group.loc[valid, ["date_str", "expiry_str", "k", "T", "cp", "price"]].copy()
    frame["model_price"] = model_prices[valid]
    frame["rel_error"] = rel
```

```json
}
```

```
def black_otm_unit(k: torch.Tensor, T: torch.Tensor, sigma: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Undiscounted OTM Black price with forward 1, strike exp(k)."""
    sqrt_t = torch.sqrt(T)
    d1 = -k / (sigma * sqrt_t) + 0.5 * sigma * sqrt_t
    d2 = d1 - sigma * sqrt_t
    call = torch.special.ndtr(d1) - torch.exp(k) * torch.special.ndtr(d2)
    put = torch.exp(k) * torch.special.ndtr(-d2) - torch.special.ndtr(-d1)
    return torch.where(k >= 0.0, call, put)


def bs_price_torch(cp: str, F: float, K: float, T: float, DF: float, sigma: torch.Tensor | float) -> torch.Tensor:
    sigma_tensor = torch.as_tensor(sigma, dtype=DTYPE)
    T_tensor = torch.as_tensor(T, dtype=DTYPE)
    sqrt_t = torch.sqrt(T_tensor)
    d1 = (math.log(F / K) + 0.5 * sigma_tensor * sigma_tensor * T_tensor) / (sigma_tensor * sqrt_t)
    d2 = d1 - sigma_tensor * sqrt_t
    if cp == "C":
        return DF * (F * torch.special.ndtr(d1) - K * torch.special.ndtr(d2))
    return DF * (K * torch.special.ndtr(-d2) - F * torch.special.ndtr(-d1))


def neural_loss(
    model: IVSurface,
    k_quotes: torch.Tensor,
    T_quotes: torch.Tensor,
    unit_market: torch.Tensor,
    colloc_k: torch.Tensor,
    colloc_T: torch.Tensor,
    t_scale: float,
    lambda1: float,
    lambda2: float,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, float, float, float]:
    sigma = model(k_quotes, T_quotes, t_scale)
    unit_model = black_otm_unit(k_quotes, T_quotes, sigma)
    price_loss = torch.mean((unit_model - unit_market) ** 2)
    reg_butterfly = torch.zeros((), dtype=DTYPE)
    reg_calendar = torch.zeros((), dtype=DTYPE)
    need_butterfly = lambda1 != 0.0
    need_calendar = lambda2 != 0.0
    if need_butterfly or need_calendar:
        k_local = colloc_k.clone().requires_grad_(True)
        T_local = colloc_T.clone().requires_grad_(True)
        w = model(k_local, T_local, t_scale) ** 2 * T_local
        if need_butterfly:
            w_k = torch.autograd.grad(w.sum(), k_local, create_graph=True)[0]
            w_kk = torch.autograd.grad(w_k.sum(), k_local, create_graph=True)[0]
            g = (
                (1.0 - k_local * w_k / (2.0 * w)) ** 2
                - (w_k * w_k / 4.0) * (1.0 / w + 1.0 / 4.0)
                + w_kk / 2.0
            )
            reg_butterfly = torch.mean(torch.relu(-g) ** 2)
        if need_calendar:
            w_T = torch.autograd.grad(w.sum(), T_local, create_graph=True)[0]
            reg_calendar = torch.mean(torch.relu(-w_T) ** 2)
    total = price_loss + lambda1 * reg_butterfly + lambda2 * reg_calendar
    return total, float(price_loss.detach()), float(reg_butterfly.detach()), float(reg_calendar.detach())


def _flat_parameters(params: list[torch.nn.Parameter]) -> torch.Tensor:
    return torch.cat([param.detach().reshape(-1) for param in params])
```

```
def svi_repricing_errors(params: np.ndarray, group: pd.DataFrame) -> np.ndarray:
    k = group.k.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    T = group["T"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    w = A1.svi_w(k, params)
    with np.errstate(invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
        sigma = np.sqrt(w / T)
    model_prices = np.array([
        A1.bs_price(cp, float(F), float(K), float(t), float(DF), float(vol))
        for cp, F, K, t, DF, vol in zip(group.cp, group.F, group.K, T, group.DF, sigma)
    ])
    market = group.price.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    valid = np.isfinite(model_prices) & np.isfinite(sigma) & (market > 0)
    return np.abs(model_prices[valid] - market[valid]) / market[valid]


def neural_audit(model: IVSurface, expiry_T: np.ndarray, t_scale: float, tol: float = BUTTERFLY_TOL) -> dict:
    Ts = np.sort(np.asarray(expiry_T, dtype=float))
    n_k = len(GRID_K)
    k = torch.tensor(np.tile(GRID_K, len(Ts)), dtype=DTYPE, requires_grad=True)
    T = torch.tensor(np.repeat(Ts, n_k), dtype=DTYPE)
    sigma = model(k, T, t_scale)
    w_tensor = sigma * sigma * T
    w_k = torch.autograd.grad(w_tensor.sum(), k, create_graph=True)[0]
    w_kk = torch.autograd.grad(w_k.sum(), k)[0]
    w = w_tensor.detach().numpy().reshape(len(Ts), n_k)
    w1 = w_k.detach().numpy().reshape(len(Ts), n_k)
    w2 = w_kk.detach().numpy().reshape(len(Ts), n_k)
    k_np = GRID_K.reshape(1, n_k)
    g = (1.0 - k_np * w1 / (2.0 * w)) ** 2 - (w1 * w1 / 4.0) * (1.0 / w + 1.0 / 4.0) + w2 / 2.0
    diff = w[1:] - w[:-1]
    return {
        "butterfly_violations_strict": int((g < 0.0).sum()),
        "butterfly_violations": int((g < -tol).sum()),
        "min_g": float(np.min(g)),
        "calendar_violations_strict": int((diff < 0.0).sum()),
        "calendar_violations": int((diff < -CALENDAR_TOL).sum()),
        "min_forward_variance": float(np.min(diff / np.diff(Ts)[:, None])) if len(Ts) > 1 else float("nan"),
        "checks_butterfly": int(g.size),
```

```
def neural_audit(model: IVSurface, expiry_T: np.ndarray, t_scale: float, tol: float = BUTTERFLY_TOL) -> dict:
    _debug("audit start")
    Ts = np.sort(np.asarray(expiry_T, dtype=float))
    n_k = len(GRID_K)
    k = torch.tensor(np.tile(GRID_K, len(Ts)), dtype=DTYPE)
    T = torch.tensor(np.repeat(Ts, n_k), dtype=DTYPE)
    w_tensor, w_k, w_kk, _ = neural_w_derivatives(model, k, T, t_scale, need_k=True, need_T=False)
    w = w_tensor.detach().numpy().reshape(len(Ts), n_k)
    w1 = w_k.detach().numpy().reshape(len(Ts), n_k)
    w2 = w_kk.detach().numpy().reshape(len(Ts), n_k)
    k_np = GRID_K.reshape(1, n_k)
    g = (1.0 - k_np * w1 / (2.0 * w)) ** 2 - (w1 * w1 / 4.0) * (1.0 / w + 1.0 / 4.0) + w2 / 2.0
    diff = w[1:] - w[:-1]
    return {
        "butterfly_violations_strict": int((g < 0.0).sum()),
        "butterfly_violations": int((g < -tol).sum()),
        "min_g": float(np.min(g)),
        "calendar_violations_strict": int((diff < 0.0).sum()),
        "calendar_violations": int((diff < -CALENDAR_TOL).sum()),
        "min_forward_variance": float(np.min(diff / np.diff(Ts)[:, None])) if len(Ts) > 1 else float("nan"),
        "checks_butterfly": int(g.size),
        "checks_calendar": int(diff.size),
    }
    _debug("audit done")


def pooled_stats(errors: np.ndarray) -> dict:
    values = np.asarray(errors, dtype=float)
    values = values[np.isfinite(values)]
```

```
This module reuses the Option A (approach1) loading, rate, parity-forward,
filter and implied-volatility code by importing ``approach1_q1a_svi.py``.

  a and m free, solved by Adam then L-BFGS, compared with scipy least_squares
  from the same starting point;
* a smooth MLP sigma_theta(k, T) fitted to OTM prices with butterfly and
  calendar penalties computed by autograd on a collocation grid;
* an in-sample lambda ablation, a random-drop and wing holdout robustness
  study, and a like-for-like comparison with approach1 on the same quotes.

    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module
```

```
def date_quotes(otm: pd.DataFrame, date: pd.Timestamp) -> pd.DataFrame:
    group = otm[otm.date == date].sort_values(["T", "K", "cp"]).copy()
    if group.empty:
        raise ValueError(f"no OTM quotes for sample date {date}")
    return group.reset_index(drop=True)


def _inv_softplus(value: float) -> float:
    value = float(value)
    if value <= 1e-12:
        return -30.0
    if value > 30.0:
        return value
    return math.log(math.expm1(value))
```

```
def neural_sigma_numpy(model: IVSurface, k: np.ndarray, T: np.ndarray, t_scale: float) -> np.ndarray:
    k_tensor = torch.tensor(np.asarray(k, dtype=float), dtype=DTYPE)
    T_tensor = torch.tensor(np.asarray(T, dtype=float), dtype=DTYPE)
    with torch.no_grad():
        sigma = model(k_tensor, T_tensor, t_scale)
    return sigma.detach().numpy()


def neural_repricing_errors(
    model: IVSurface,
    group: pd.DataFrame,
    t_scale: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, pd.DataFrame]:
    sigma = neural_sigma_numpy(model, group.k.to_numpy(dtype=float), group["T"].to_numpy(dtype=float), t_scale)
    model_prices = np.array([
        A1.bs_price(cp, float(F), float(K), float(T), float(DF), float(vol))
        for cp, F, K, T, DF, vol in zip(group.cp, group.F, group.K, group["T"], group.DF, sigma)
    ])
    market = group.price.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    valid = np.isfinite(model_prices) & np.isfinite(sigma) & (market > 0)
    rel = np.abs(model_prices[valid] - market[valid]) / market[valid]
    frame = group.loc[valid, ["date_str", "expiry_str", "k", "T", "cp", "price"]].copy()
    frame["model_price"] = model_prices[valid]
    frame["rel_error"] = rel
    return rel, frame
```

```
            "quotes and scored only on held-out quotes. Expiries with fewer than min_strikes "
            "training quotes, or where SVI fit failed, are excluded from both models. SVI refits are warm-started from the full-sample approach1 fit when available; neural refits start from a fresh seeded initialisation."
        ),
        "per_seed": [
            {"design": design, "seed": seed, "model": model_name, **pooled_stats(np.asarray(values, dtype=float))}
            for (design, seed, model_name), values in sorted(per_seed.items())
        ],
    }
    return frame, summary


def build_surface_frame(
    models: dict,
    sample_dates: list[pd.Timestamp],
    chosen: tuple[float, float],
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for date in sample_dates:
        date_str = pd.Timestamp(date).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        item = models[(date_str, chosen[0], chosen[1])]
        model = item["model"]
        t_scale = item["t_scale"]
        expiry_T = np.sort(np.asarray(item["info"]["expiry_T"], dtype=float))
        T_grid = np.unique(np.concatenate([
            expiry_T,
            np.linspace(float(expiry_T.min()), float(expiry_T.max()), 25),
        ]))
        k_grid, t_mesh = np.meshgrid(SURFACE_K, T_grid)
        sigma = neural_sigma_numpy(model, k_grid.reshape(-1), t_mesh.reshape(-1), t_scale).reshape(k_grid.shape)
        w = sigma * sigma * t_mesh
        rows.append(pd.DataFrame({
            "date": date_str,
            "k": k_grid.reshape(-1),
            "T": t_mesh.reshape(-1),
            "sigma": sigma.reshape(-1),
            "w": w.reshape(-1),
            "is_expiry": np.isin(np.round(t_mesh.reshape(-1), 12), np.round(expiry_T, 12)),
        }))
    return pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)


def build_svi_convergence(histories: list[dict], out_path: Path) -> None:
    dates = sorted({item["date"] for item in histories})
    max_expiries = max(len([item for item in histories if item["date"] == date]) for date in dates)
    titles = []
    for date in dates:
        items = sorted([item for item in histories if item["date"] == date], key=lambda item: item["T"])
        titles.extend([f"{date} exp {index + 1}" for index in range(len(items))])
        titles.extend([""] * (max_expiries - len(items)))
    fig = make_subplots(
        rows=len(dates),
        cols=max_expiries,
        subplot_titles=titles,
        vertical_spacing=0.035,
        horizontal_spacing=0.035,
    )
    for row_index, date in enumerate(dates, start=1):
```

```
    params_by_key = {

        })

        "basis": "approach1 repaired SVI parameters from svi_params.csv, re-priced on this run's OTM quote set",
        "common_quotes": int(len(neural_errors)),
        "neural": pooled_stats(np.asarray(neural_errors, dtype=float)),
        "approach1": pooled_stats(np.asarray(approach1_errors, dtype=float)),
        "per_date": per_date,
        "missing_approach1_expiries": missing,
    }
```

```
def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict:
    console = Console(width=220)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    set_seed(args.seed)
    set_torch_threads(args.torch_threads)
    out_dir = ensure_inside_repo(args.out_dir)
    log = RunLog(args.log_path, console)
    log.write(f"start seed={args.seed} torch_threads={args.torch_threads}")
    if not (0.0 < args.eta_min < args.eta_max):
        raise ValueError("require 0 < eta_min < eta_max")
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    console.print("[bold]Loading and verifying data (approach1 loaders)[/bold]")
    options, shibor, metadata = A1.load_data(args.options, args.shibor, args.metadata)
    console.print(f"  options rows={len(options):,} dates={options.date.nunique()} expiries={options.expiry.nunique()}")
    console.print(f"  shibor rows={len(shibor):,} range={shibor.date.min().date()}..{shibor.date.max().date()}")

    console.print("[bold]Forwards, filters and implied vols (approach1 functions)[/bold]")
    forwards, _ = A1.estimate_forwards(options, shibor, args.price_col)
    data, filter_counts = A1.apply_filters(options, forwards, args)
    iv, _, iv_stats = A1.compute_implied_vols(data[data.liquid])
    console.print(f"  liquid quotes={filter_counts['quotes_liquid']:,}/{filter_counts['quotes_total']:,} | IV ok={iv_stats['ok_quotes']:,}")

    sample_dates, sample_rows = select_sample_dates(options, metadata)
    console.print("[bold]Sample dates[/bold]")
    for row in sample_rows:
        flag = "match" if row["matches_metadata"] else f"metadata={row['metadata_date']}"
        console.print(
            f"  {row['month']}: max={row['max_quotes']} threshold={row['threshold_80pct']:.1f} "
            f"chosen={row['date']} ({row['date_rows']} rows) {flag}"
        )
    otm, otm_info = build_otm_quotes(data, iv, sample_dates, args.min_strikes)
    console.print(f"  OTM quotes={otm_info['otm_quotes']:,} | date-expiry fits={otm_info['date_expiry_fits']}")

    console.print("[bold]Step 1: differentiable SVI vs scipy[/bold]")
    solver_start = time.perf_counter()
    reference_bounds = A1.svi_bounds(args.eta_min, args.eta_max)
```

```
def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = parse_args(argv)
    run(args)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

## Verification tests
`python tests/test_neural_q1b.py` — **4/4 pass** after the final code changes:
- autograd `w', w'', dw/dT` match finite differences;
- torch `g` matches approach1 analytic `g`;
- torch Black price matches approach1 to `1e-10`;
- torch SVI recovers synthetic parameters.

## Thread environment and process isolation
- Setting `OMP_NUM_THREADS=1`, `MKL_NUM_THREADS=1`, `OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1`, `NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1` before torch import, plus `torch.set_num_threads(1)`, **fixed the minimal repeated high-order autograd reproduction**: 6/6 runs completed at ~2.9 s each; without them it stalled on the third run. This is documented in the code comments.
- Each neural fit runs in a fresh spawned process, 120 s timeout, one retry with the same seed. **0 timeouts, 0 failed fits**.
- Cold run: 80 cache misses. Cached rerun: 78 hits + 2 determinism reruns, 49.6 s.
- Determinism test: same seed, two fresh fits → loss difference `0.0`, max state difference `0.0`. **No nondeterminism observed** (no AGENTS rule 3 exception).
- Seeds are `sha256(base_seed|date|lambda1|lambda2|design|rep) mod (2^31-1)`.

## Runtime
Cold full run: **802.8 s (13.4 min)**, `fit_seconds = 798.4 s`, well under 45 min. Coverage: ablation **54/54**, neural robustness **24/24**, SVI robustness **24/24**, determinism **2/2**.

## Sample dates
The 80% rule gives `2024-03-14`, not metadata’s `2024-03-15` (2024-03-15 has 180 quotes = 75% of the month’s 240 maximum, below 80%). The other five match. This is recorded in `metrics.json`.

## SVI solver comparison (30 fits)
| Metric | Torch Adam+L-BFGS | scipy least_squares |
|---|---:|---:|
| fits reaching 0.1% tolerance | **29/30** | **30/30** |
| median final objective | 6.560e-09 | 6.559e-09 |
| max final objective | 3.513e-07 | 3.513e-07 |
| median iterations to tolerance | 0.0 | 5.5 nfev |
| median wall time | 0.187 s | 0.00071 s |
| total wall time | 5.93 s | 1.85 s |

The one miss: `2024-09-13 / 2024-12-20`, torch `9.4045e-09` vs scipy `9.3941e-09` (0.111% gap).  
Important caveat: both solvers start from approach1’s raw fit. Torch’s final objective equals the start objective on all 30 fits; Adam/L-BFGS did not improve the start. The 29/30 tolerance success largely reflects starting at/near the optimum. scipy improved one slice by 0.11%, which torch missed.

## Ablation (pooled in-sample OTM relative repricing error)
All pairs have 6/6 fits. Only `(0, 0.01)` has butterfly violations.

| λ1 | λ2 | median | p95 | max | butterfly | calendar |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 | 0 | 0.0530 | 0.6936 | 0.9979 | 0 | 0 |
| 0 | 0.01 | 0.0638 | 0.7283 | 0.9914 | **3** | 0 |
| 0 | 1 | 0.0639 | 0.7117 | 0.9972 | 0 | 0 |
| 0.01 | 0 | 0.0571 | 0.7032 | 0.9944 | 0 | 0 |
| 0.01 | 0.01 | 0.0680 | 0.6580 | 0.9952 | 0 | 0 |
| 0.01 | 1 | 0.0669 | 0.7366 | 0.9912 | 0 | 0 |
| 1 | 0 | 0.0555 | 0.7044 | 0.9914 | 0 | 0 |
| **1** | **0.01** | **0.0443** | **0.6784** | **0.9819** | **0** | **0** |
| 1 | 1 | 0.0531 | 0.6042 | 0.9904 | 0 | 0 |

**Chosen lambdas: `(1.0, 0.01)`.** Rule: complete fit coverage, zero butterfly/calendar violations at `1e-8` on the approach1 grid, minimum pooled in-sample OTM median relative repricing error, tie-break by max error. No held-out robustness data were used. Unpenalized `(0,0)` is reported above: median `0.0530`, p95 `0.6936`, max `0.9979`, zero violations.

Caveat: each lambda pair has a different derived seed, so lambda effects are confounded with initialization noise. The chosen pair’s advantage over unpenalized is small.

## Robustness (pooled held-out OTM relative price error)
| Design | Model | fits | n | median | p95 |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| random | SVI | 18/18 | 396 | 0.013754 | 0.102170 |
| random | neural | 18/18 | 396 | 0.064335 | 0.752058 |
| wing | SVI | 6/6 | 83 | 0.050337 | 0.559186 |
| wing | neural | 6/6 | 83 | 0.435813 | 0.968057 |

8 of 24 unique robustness splits each excluded one expiry because fewer than 6 training quotes remained; these are listed in `robustness.csv`, not silently dropped.

**Wing conclusion:** neural has much higher absolute wing error (median `0.436` vs `0.050`; p95 `0.968` vs `0.559`). Measured as increase over random holdouts, neural degrades more in median (`+0.371` vs `+0.0366`), while SVI degrades more in p95 (`+0.457` vs `+0.216`).

## Violations
Chosen neural surface: **0 butterfly strict/tolerance, 0 calendar strict/tolerance**; min `g = 0.2476`, min forward variance `0.02255`. The rejected `(0, 0.01)` ablation fit had 3 butterfly violations and `min g = -0.4445`.

## Comparison with approach1 on the same 470 OTM quotes
| Model | n | median | p95 | max |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| approach1 repaired SVI | 470 | 0.008214 | 0.054525 | 0.173657 |
| neural chosen `(1, 0.01)` | 470 | 0.044285 | 0.678359 | 0.981883 |

The neural surface is substantially worse than approach1 SVI, especially in the tails.

## Things that look wrong / caveats
- Neural wing errors are very large: p95 repricing error `67.8%`, max `98.2%`. The price-space loss weights ATM prices, so cheap deep-OTM quotes are poorly fit. The network also fits one smooth surface across all expiries, unlike per-expiry SVI.
- The lambda ablation is noisy because each lambda gets a different required seed.
- Torch SVI L-BFGS does not improve the approach1 start; the solver comparison is therefore a weak test of torch’s ability from a poor initialization.
- scipy hit its `nfev=4000` cap on three slices.
- Relative errors above 1 are possible for very cheap wing quotes (SVI wing p95 `1.126`).
- `2024-03` sample date differs from metadata for the reason above.

Outputs are in `results/approach2/io/`: `metrics.json`, `solver_comparison.csv`, `ablation.csv`, `ablation_aggregate.csv`, `robustness.csv`, `surface.csv`, `svi_convergence.html`, `surface.html`.

```
91: def record(name: str, status: str, detail: str = "", path: str | None = None):
92:     INTERFACES.append(
93:         {
94:             "interface": name,
95:             "status": status,
96:             "detail": detail,
97:             "path": path,
98:             "retrieved_at": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
99:         }
100:     )
101: 
102: 
103: def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
104:     digest = hashlib.sha256()
105:     with path.open("rb") as handle:
106:         for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1 << 20), b""):
107:             digest.update(chunk)
108:     return digest.hexdigest()
109: 
110: 
111: def weekdays_in_month(month: str):
112:     year, mon = map(int, month.split("-"))
113:     current = date(year, mon, 1)
114:     while current.month == mon:
115:         if current.weekday() < 5:
116:             yield current
117:         current += timedelta(days=1)
118: 
119: 
120: def third_friday(year: int, month: int) -> date:
121:     current = date(year, month, 1)
122:     fridays = []
123:     while current.month == month:
124:         if current.weekday() == 4:
125:             fridays.append(current)
126:         current += timedelta(days=1)
127:     return fridays[2]
128:

130: def fetch_cffex(session: requests.Session):
131:     CFFEX_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
132:     ok = skipped = non200 = noncsv = errors = 0
133:     failed_dates: list[dict] = []
134:     for month in SAMPLE_MONTHS:
135:         for day in weekdays_in_month(month):
136:             path = CFFEX_DIR / f"{day:%Y%m%d}_1.csv"
137:             if path.exists() and path.stat().st_size > 0:
138:                 existing = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
139:                 skipped += 1
140:                 if "合约代码" not in existing:
141:                     noncsv += 1
142:                     failed_dates.append({"date": day.isoformat(), "status": "non_csv_200"})
143:                     log.info("CFFEX %s cached response is a non-CSV holiday page; not refetching", day)
144:                 continue
145:             url = CFFEX_URL.format(ym=f"{day:%Y%m}", dd=f"{day:%d}", ymd=f"{day:%Y%m%d}")
146:             try:
147:                 response = session.get(url, headers={"User-Agent": USER_AGENT}, timeout=(10, 30))
148:                 if response.status_code != 200:
149:                     non200 += 1
150:                     failed_dates.append({"date": day.isoformat(), "status": response.status_code})
151:                     log.warning("CFFEX %s returned %s (probable holiday)", day, response.status_code)
152:                 else:
153:                     text = response.content.decode("gbk", errors="replace")
154:                     if "合约代码" not in text:
155:                         noncsv += 1
156:                         failed_dates.append({"date": day.isoformat(), "status": "non_csv_200"})
157:                         log.warning("CFFEX %s returned a non-CSV page with 200 (probable holiday)", day)
158:                     else:
159:                         path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
160:                         ok += 1
161:             except Exception as exc:
162:                 errors += 1
163:                 failed_dates.append(
164:                     {"date": day.isoformat(), "status": "error", "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"}
165:                 )
166:                 log.error("CFFEX %s failed: %s: %s", day, type(exc).__name__, exc)
167:             time.sleep(0.3)
168:     detail = f"downloaded={ok} skipped={skipped} non200={non200} noncsv200={noncsv} errors={errors}"
169:     status = "ok" if errors == 0 else "partial"
170:     record("CFFEX daily quotes", status, detail, str(CFFEX_DIR))
171:     if failed_dates:
172:         log.info("CFFEX non-200/error dates: %s", failed_dates)
173:

308: def resolve_expiry_dates(csi: pd.DataFrame, nominal_dates: set[date]) -> tuple[dict[date, date], dict]:
309:     calendar = sorted(csi["date"])
310:     calendar_set = set(calendar)
311:     if not calendar:
312:         mapping = {nominal: nominal for nominal in nominal_dates}
313:         validation = {
314:             "calendar_start": None,
315:             "calendar_end": None,
316:             "rolled": [],
317:             "verified": [],
318:             "unverified_future": sorted(nominal.isoformat() for nominal in nominal_dates),
319:         }
320:         return mapping, validation
321:     last = calendar[-1]
322:     mapping = {}
323:     rolled = []
324:     verified = []
325:     unverified_future = []
326:     for nominal in sorted(nominal_dates):
327:         if nominal > last:
328:             mapping[nominal] = nominal
329:             unverified_future.append(nominal.isoformat())
330:         elif nominal in calendar_set:
331:             mapping[nominal] = nominal
332:             verified.append(nominal.isoformat())
333:         else:
334:             rolled_to = next((day for day in calendar if day > nominal), None)
335:             if rolled_to is None:
336:                 mapping[nominal] = nominal
337:                 unverified_future.append(nominal.isoformat())
338:             else:
339:                 mapping[nominal] = rolled_to
340:                 rolled.append(
341:                     {
342:                         "nominal": nominal.isoformat(),
343:                         "expiry": rolled_to.isoformat(),
344:                         "reason": "holiday_roll",
345:                     }
346:                 )
347:     validation = {
348:         "calendar_start": calendar[0].isoformat(),
349:         "calendar_end": last.isoformat(),
350:         "rolled": rolled,
351:         "verified": verified,
352:         "unverified_future": unverified_future,
353:     }
354:     return mapping, validation
355:

357: def build_options(csi: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict]:
358:     csi_close = dict(zip(csi["date"], csi["close"]))
359:     csi_dates = set(csi["date"])
360:     frames = []
361:     files = sorted(CFFEX_DIR.glob("*_1.csv"))
362:     raw_io = 0
363:     ignored_non_io = 0
364:     invalid_codes = 0
365:     for path in files:
366:         day = datetime.strptime(path.stem.split("_")[0], "%Y%m%d").date()
367:         frame = pd.read_csv(path, dtype=str, encoding="utf-8-sig")
368:         frame.columns = [str(column).strip() for column in frame.columns]
369:         if "合约代码" not in frame.columns:
370:             log.warning("CFFEX %s has no 合约代码 column; skipped", path.name)
371:             continue
372:         frame["contract"] = frame["合约代码"].str.strip()
373:         is_io = frame["contract"].str.upper().str.startswith("IO", na=False)
374:         ignored_non_io += int((~is_io).sum())
375:         frame = frame[is_io].copy()
376:         if frame.empty:
377:             continue
378:         parsed = frame["contract"].str.extract(
379:             r"(?i)^IO(\d{2})(\d{2})-?([CP])-?(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)$"
380:         )
381:         invalid = parsed.isna().any(axis=1)
382:         invalid_codes += int(invalid.sum())
383:         frame = frame[~invalid].copy()
384:         parsed = parsed[~invalid].copy()
385:         if frame.empty:
386:             continue
387:         frame["date"] = day
388:         frame["expiry"] = [
389:             third_friday(2000 + int(year), int(month))
390:             for year, month in zip(parsed[0], parsed[1])
391:         ]
392:         frame["cp"] = parsed[2].str.upper()
393:         frame["K"] = pd.to_numeric(parsed[3], errors="coerce")
394:         for source, target in [
395:             ("今开盘", "open"),
396:             ("最高价", "high"),
397:             ("最低价", "low"),
398:             ("今收盘", "close"),
399:             ("今结算", "settle"),
400:             ("成交量", "volume"),
401:             ("持仓量", "oi"),
402:         ]:
403:             frame[target] = pd.to_numeric(frame[source], errors="coerce")
404:         frame["S"] = frame["date"].map(csi_close)
405:         raw_io += len(frame)
406:         frames.append(frame[["date", "contract", "expiry", "cp", "K", "open", "high", "low", "close", "settle", "volume", "oi", "S"]])
407:     if not frames:
408:         empty = pd.DataFrame(columns=OPTION_COLUMNS)
409:         return empty, {
410:             "raw_io_rows": 0,
411:             "ignored_non_io": ignored_non_io,
412:             "invalid_codes": invalid_codes,
413:             "dropped_on_or_after_expiry": 0,
414:             "expiry_flags": [],
415:             "expiry_validation": {
416:                 "calendar_start": None,
417:                 "calendar_end": None,
418:                 "rolled": [],
419:                 "verified": [],
420:                 "unverified_future": [],
421:             },
422:         }
423:     options = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
424:     nominal_dates = set(options["expiry"])
425:     expiry_mapping, expiry_validation = resolve_expiry_dates(csi, nominal_dates)
426:     options["expiry"] = options["expiry"].map(expiry_mapping)
427:     options = options[options["K"] > 0].copy()
428:     dropped = options[options["date"] >= options["expiry"]].copy()
429:     dropped_count = len(dropped)
430:     if dropped_count:
431:         log.warning(
432:             "dropping %d IO rows with date >= expiry (expiry-day rows): %s",
433:             dropped_count,
434:             sorted({str(value) for value in dropped["expiry"].unique()}),
435:         )
436:     options = options[options["expiry"] > options["date"]].copy()
437:     options["date"] = pd.to_datetime(options["date"]).dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
438:     options["expiry"] = pd.to_datetime(options["expiry"]).dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
439:     options = options.sort_values(["date", "expiry", "cp", "K"]).reset_index(drop=True)
440:     expiry_flags = [
441:         {"expiry": expiry, "reason": "unverified_future"}
442:         for expiry in expiry_validation["unverified_future"]
443:     ]
444:     for item in expiry_validation["rolled"]:
445:         log.info("expiry %s rolled to %s", item["nominal"], item["expiry"])
446:     for expiry in expiry_validation["unverified_future"]:
447:         log.warning("expiry %s is unverified_future", expiry)
448:     stats = {
449:         "raw_io_rows": raw_io,
450:         "ignored_non_io": ignored_non_io,
451:         "invalid_codes": invalid_codes,
452:         "dropped_on_or_after_expiry": dropped_count,
453:         "expiry_flags": expiry_flags,
454:         "expiry_validation": expiry_validation,
455:     }
456:     return options, stats
457:

486: def choose_sample_dates(options: pd.DataFrame) -> list[str]:
487:     if options.empty:
488:         return []
489:     available = sorted(pd.to_datetime(options["date"]).dt.date.unique())
490:     chosen = []
491:     for month in SAMPLE_MONTHS:
492:         candidates = [day for day in available if day.strftime("%Y-%m") == month]
493:         if not candidates:
494:             log.warning("no trading dates for sample month %s", month)
495:             continue
496:         mid = [day for day in candidates if 10 <= day.day <= 20]
497:         pool = mid if mid else candidates
498:         ranked = sorted(pool, key=lambda day: (abs(day.day - 15), day.day))
499:         selection = None
500:         for day in ranked:
501:             mask = options["date"] == day.isoformat()
502:             if options.loc[mask, "expiry"].nunique() >= 4:
503:                 selection = day
504:                 break
505:         if selection is None:
506:             selection = ranked[0]
507:             log.warning("sample date %s has fewer than 4 expiries", selection)
508:         chosen.append(selection.isoformat())
509:     return chosen

517: def fetch_sina_comparison(options: pd.DataFrame, sample_dates: list[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
518:     raw_path = RAW / "sina_comparison.csv"
519:     if raw_path.exists() and raw_path.stat().st_size > 0:
520:         cached = pd.read_csv(raw_path, dtype=str)
521:         covered = bool(sample_dates) and all(
522:             int((cached["date"] == day).sum()) >= 5 for day in sample_dates
523:         )
524:         if covered:
525:             record("Sina option cross-check", "skipped", "cached comparison", str(raw_path))
526:             log.info("Sina cross-check skipped; cached comparison covers all sample dates")
527:             return cached
528:         log.info("Sina cross-check cache does not cover current sample dates; refetching")
529:     import akshare as ak
530: 
531:     rows = []
532:     for day in sample_dates:
533:         subset = options[options["date"] == day].copy()
534:         subset["distance"] = (subset["K"] - subset["S"]).abs()
535:         near = subset.sort_values(["distance", "contract"]).drop_duplicates("contract").head(5)
536:         for item in near.itertuples(index=False):
537:             symbol = sina_symbol(item.contract)
538:             status = "ok"
539:             error = ""
540:             sina_close = None
541:             try:
542:                 with time_limit(30):
543:                     frame = ak.option_cffex_hs300_daily_sina(symbol=symbol)
544:                 frame.columns = [str(column).strip() for column in frame.columns]
545:                 date_col = "date" if "date" in frame.columns else "日期"
546:                 close_col = "close" if "close" in frame.columns else "收盘价"
547:                 frame[date_col] = pd.to_datetime(frame[date_col], errors="coerce").dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
548:                 match = frame[frame[date_col] == day]
549:                 if match.empty:
550:                     status = "no_matching_date"
551:                     error = f"no Sina row for {day}"
552:                 else:
553:                     sina_close = float(pd.to_numeric(match[close_col], errors="coerce").iloc[0])
554:             except Exception as exc:
555:                 status = "failed"
556:                 error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
557:                 log.error("Sina cross-check %s %s failed: %s", day, item.contract, error)
558:             diff = None
559:             if sina_close is not None and pd.notna(item.close):
560:                 diff = float(item.close) - sina_close
561:             rows.append(
562:                 {
563:                     "date": day,
564:                     "contract": item.contract,
565:                     "sina_symbol": symbol,
566:                     "cffex_close": item.close,
567:                     "sina_close": sina_close,
568:                     "diff": diff,
569:                     "status": status,
570:                     "error": error,
571:                 }
572:             )
573:             time.sleep(0.3)
574:     frame = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=SINA_COLUMNS)
575:     frame.to_csv(raw_path, index=False, encoding="utf-8")
576:     ok = int((frame["status"] == "ok").sum())
577:     record("Sina option cross-check", "ok" if ok else "failed", f"compared={ok} rows={len(frame)}", str(raw_path))
578:     return frame
579:

581: def run_assertions(
582:     options: pd.DataFrame,
583:     shibor: pd.DataFrame,
584:     sample_dates: list[str],
585:     csi: pd.DataFrame,
586: ) -> list[dict]:
587:     checks = []
588: 
589:     def check(name: str, condition: bool, detail: str):
590:         checks.append({"name": name, "passed": bool(condition), "detail": detail})
591:         if condition:
592:             log.info("assertion passed: %s (%s)", name, detail)
593:         else:
594:             log.error("assertion FAILED: %s (%s)", name, detail)
595: 
596:     duplicates = int(options.duplicated(["date", "contract"]).sum()) if not options.empty else 0
597:     check("no duplicate date+contract", duplicates == 0, f"duplicates={duplicates}")
598: 
599:     bad_k = int((pd.to_numeric(options["K"], errors="coerce") <= 0).sum()) if not options.empty else 0
600:     check("K > 0", bad_k == 0, f"violations={bad_k}")
601: 
602:     if options.empty:
603:         cp_ok = False
604:         cp_detail = "options table is empty"
605:         expiries_per_date = {}
606:     else:
607:         grouped = options.groupby(["date", "expiry", "K"])["cp"].nunique()
608:         incomplete = int((grouped != 2).sum())
609:         cp_ok = incomplete == 0
610:         cp_detail = f"date+expiry+K groups without both C and P={incomplete}"
611:         expiries_per_date = options.groupby("date")["expiry"].nunique().to_dict()
612:     check("C and P both present", cp_ok, cp_detail)
613: 
614:     expiry_ok = bool((pd.to_datetime(options["expiry"]) > pd.to_datetime(options["date"])).all()) if not options.empty else False
615:     check("expiry after date", expiry_ok, "all retained rows have expiry > date")
616: 
617:     if options.empty or csi.empty:
618:         historical_ok = False
619:         historical_detail = "options or CSI calendar is empty"
620:     else:
621:         calendar = set(pd.to_datetime(csi["date"]).dt.date)
622:         last_calendar_day = max(calendar)
623:         expiries = sorted(pd.to_datetime(options["expiry"]).dt.date.unique())
624:         historical = [day for day in expiries if day <= last_calendar_day]
625:         missing_expiries = [day.isoformat() for day in historical if day not in calendar]
626:         historical_ok = bool(historical) and not missing_expiries
627:         historical_detail = f"historical_expiries={len(historical)} non_trading={missing_expiries}"
628:     check("each historical expiry is a trading day", historical_ok, historical_detail)
629: 
630:     missing_s = int(options["S"].isna().sum()) if not options.empty else 0
631:     check("S present on every date", missing_s == 0, f"rows missing S={missing_s}")
632: 
633:     if sample_dates:
634:         span = (date.fromisoformat(max(sample_dates)) - date.fromisoformat(min(sample_dates))).days
635:     else:
636:         span = 0
637:     check(
638:         "at least 5 sample dates spanning at least 2 years",
639:         len(sample_dates) >= 5 and span >= 730,
640:         f"sample_dates={len(sample_dates)} span_days={span}",
641:     )
642: 
643:     min_expiries = min((expiries_per_date.get(day, 0) for day in sample_dates), default=0)
644:     check(
645:         "at least 4 expiries per sample date",
646:         bool(sample_dates) and min_expiries >= 4,
647:         f"minimum expiries across sample dates={min_expiries}",
648:     )
649:     return checks
650: 
651: 
652: def build_artifact(path: Path, source: str, interface: str, schema: list[str], rows: int) -> dict:
653:     return {
654:         "path": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),
655:         "source": source,
656:         "interface": interface,
657:         "retrieval_time": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
658:         "schema": schema,
659:         "rows": rows,
660:         "sha256": sha256(path),
661:     }
662: 
663: 
664: def write_metadata(
665:     options: pd.DataFrame,
666:     shibor: pd.DataFrame,
667:     sina: pd.DataFrame,
668:     csi_source: str,
669:     build_stats: dict,
670:     sample_dates: list[str],
671:     assertions: list[dict],
672: ):
673:     import akshare
674: 
675:     month_report = []
676:     for month in SAMPLE_MONTHS:
677:         subset = options[options["date"].str.startswith(month)] if not options.empty else options
678:         month_report.append(
679:             {
680:                 "month": month,
681:                 "trading_days": int(subset["date"].nunique()) if not subset.empty else 0,
682:                 "rows": int(len(subset)),
683:             }
684:         )
685:     date_report = []
686:     for day in sample_dates:
687:         subset = options[options["date"] == day]
688:         date_report.append(
689:             {
690:                 "date": day,
691:                 "rows": int(len(subset)),
692:                 "expiries": int(subset["expiry"].nunique()),
693:             }
694:         )
695:     metadata = {
696:         "created_at": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
697:         "akshare_version": akshare.__version__,
698:         "artifacts": {
699:             "data/clean/options_io.csv": build_artifact(
700:                 CLEAN / "options_io.csv",
701:                 f"CFFEX IO daily quotes; CSI 300 close from {csi_source}",
702:                 "http://www.cffex.com.cn/sj/hqsj/rtj/ + akshare index interfaces",
703:                 OPTION_COLUMNS,
704:                 len(options),
705:             ),
706:             "data/clean/shibor.csv": build_artifact(
707:                 CLEAN / "shibor.csv",
708:                 "China Shibor",
709:                 "akshare.macro_china_shibor_all",
710:                 SHIBOR_COLUMNS,
711:                 len(shibor),
712:             ),
713:             "data/clean/sina_comparison.csv": build_artifact(
714:                 CLEAN / "sina_comparison.csv",
715:                 "CFFEX close vs Sina option daily close",
716:                 "akshare.option_cffex_hs300_daily_sina",
717:                 SINA_COLUMNS,
718:                 len(sina),
719:             ),
720:         },
721:         "interfaces": INTERFACES,
722:         "csi_source": csi_source,
723:         "build_stats": build_stats,
724:         "sample_dates": sample_dates,
725:         "sample_month_report": month_report,
726:         "sample_date_report": date_report,
727:         "assertions": assertions,
728:     }
729:     METADATA.write_text(json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
730:     return month_report, date_report

802:     fetch_etf("510300")

815:     )

817:     failed = [item["name"] for item in assertions if not item["passed"]]
818:     if failed:
819:         log.error("assertion failures: %s", failed)
820:         return 1

822:     return 0

825: def offline():
826:     if not METADATA.exists():
827:         log.error("metadata missing: %s", METADATA)
828:         return 1
829:     metadata = json.loads(METADATA.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
830:     artifacts = metadata.get("artifacts", {})
831:     if not artifacts:
832:         log.error("metadata contains no artifacts")
833:         return 1
834:     failed = []
835:     for relative, info in artifacts.items():
836:         path = ROOT / relative
837:         if not path.exists():
838:             log.error("OFFLINE missing %s", relative)
839:             failed.append(relative)
840:             continue
841:         actual = sha256(path)
842:         expected = info.get("sha256")
843:         if actual != expected:
844:             log.error("OFFLINE checksum mismatch %s expected=%s actual=%s", relative, expected, actual)
845:             failed.append(relative)
846:         else:
847:             log.info("OFFLINE OK %s rows=%s sha256=%s", relative, info.get("rows"), actual)
848:     if failed:
849:         return 1
850:     log.info("offline verification complete; all checksums match")
851:     return 0
852:

854: def main() -> int:
855:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Fetch Q1 option, index and rates data")
856:     group = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
857:     group.add_argument("--online", action="store_true", help="download missing raw data and rebuild clean artifacts")
858:     group.add_argument("--offline", action="store_true", help="verify clean artifacts against metadata checksums")
859:     args = parser.parse_args()
860:     logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s")
861:     return online() if args.online else offline()
```

```
166: def build_rate_curves(shibor: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict[pd.Timestamp, tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]]]:
167:     taus = np.array([PILLAR_DAYS[name] / 365.0 for name in PILLAR_DAYS], dtype=float)

171:         date = pd.Timestamp(row["date"])
172:         levels = np.array([row[name] for name in PILLAR_DAYS], dtype=float)
173:         if not np.all(np.isfinite(levels)):
174:             continue
175:         zeros = np.log1p((levels / 100.0) * taus * (365.0 / 360.0)) / taus
176:         curves[date] = (taus, zeros)
177:         for name, tau, level, zero in zip(PILLAR_DAYS, taus, levels, zeros):
178:             zero_rows.append((date, name, tau, level, zero))
179:     return pd.DataFrame(zero_rows, columns=["date", "pillar", "tau", "level_pct", "zero_rate"]), curves

182: def zero_rate(curves: dict[pd.Timestamp, tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]], sorted_dates: np.ndarray, date: pd.Timestamp, T: float) -> tuple[float, pd.Timestamp]:
183:     idx = int(np.searchsorted(sorted_dates, np.datetime64(date), side="right") - 1)
184:     if idx < 0:
185:         idx = 0
186:     curve_date = pd.Timestamp(sorted_dates[idx])
187:     taus, zeros = curves[curve_date]
188:     return float(np.interp(T, taus, zeros)), curve_date

191: def estimate_forward_pair(
192:     K: np.ndarray,
193:     C: np.ndarray,
194:     P: np.ndarray,
195:     vol_c: np.ndarray,
196:     vol_p: np.ndarray,
197:     DF: float,
198:     S0: float,
199:     r: float,
200:     T: float,
201:     band: float = 0.05,
202: ) -> dict:
203:     Fk = K + (C - P) / DF
204:     positive = np.isfinite(Fk) & (Fk > 0)
205:     if not np.any(positive):
206:         F = S0 / DF
207:         return {
208:             "F": float(F),
209:             "F_median": float(F),
210:             "Fk": Fk,
211:             "in_band": np.zeros_like(Fk, dtype=bool),
212:             "fallback": True,
213:             "resid_S0": C - P - (S0 - K * np.exp(-r * T)),
214:             "resid_F": C - P - DF * (F - K),
215:         }
216:     median_f = float(np.median(Fk[positive]))
217:     in_band = positive & (np.abs(np.log(Fk / median_f)) <= band)
218:     weights = np.maximum(vol_c + vol_p, 0.0)
219:     if np.sum(weights[in_band]) > 0:
220:         F = float(np.sum(weights[in_band] * Fk[in_band]) / np.sum(weights[in_band]))
221:     else:
222:         F = float(np.mean(Fk[in_band]))
223:     return {
224:         "F": F,
225:         "F_median": median_f,
226:         "Fk": Fk,
227:         "in_band": in_band,
228:         "fallback": False,
229:         "resid_S0": C - P - (S0 - K * np.exp(-r * T)),
230:         "resid_F": C - P - DF * (F - K),
231:     }
```

```
"""Verification tests for the Q1B differentiable SVI and neural surface."""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import math
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
MODULE_PATH = ROOT / "code" / "approach2_q1b_neural.py"
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("approach2_q1b_neural", MODULE_PATH)
assert SPEC is not None and SPEC.loader is not None
Q1B = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
SPEC.loader.exec_module(Q1B)
A1 = Q1B.A1

torch.set_num_threads(1)
torch.manual_seed(0)

TRUE_PARAMS = np.array([-0.005, 0.15, -0.40, -0.03, 0.12])
TRUE_F = 4000.0
TRUE_R = 0.02
TRUE_T = 0.50


class TestNeuralQ1B(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_autograd_w_and_dwdT_match_finite_differences(self):
        k = np.linspace(-0.12, 0.12, 9)
        params = np.array([0.02, 0.12, -0.45, -0.02, 0.14])
        model = Q1B.TorchSVI(params)
        k_tensor = torch.tensor(k, dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        w, w1, _, _ = Q1B.torch_svi_g(k_tensor, model)
        w1_auto = torch.autograd.grad(w.sum(), k_tensor, create_graph=True)[0]
        w2_auto = torch.autograd.grad(w1_auto.sum(), k_tensor)[0]

        h = 1e-5
        w_plus = A1.svi_w(k + h, params)
        w_minus = A1.svi_w(k - h, params)
        w1_fd = (w_plus - w_minus) / (2.0 * h)
        w2_fd = (w_plus - 2.0 * A1.svi_w(k, params) + w_minus) / (h * h)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(w1_auto.detach().numpy(), w1_fd, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-8)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(w2_auto.detach().numpy(), w2_fd, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-7)

        network = Q1B.IVSurface(hidden=12, hidden_layers=2)
        k_point = torch.tensor(k, dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        T_point = torch.tensor(np.linspace(0.08, 1.1, len(k)), dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        t_scale = math.sqrt(1.1)
        sigma = network(k_point, T_point, t_scale)
        w_network = sigma * sigma * T_point
        w_k_auto = torch.autograd.grad(w_network.sum(), k_point, create_graph=True)[0]
        w_T_auto = torch.autograd.grad(w_network.sum(), T_point, create_graph=True)[0]

        h_k = 1e-5
        with torch.no_grad():
            w_k_plus = network(k_point + h_k, T_point, t_scale) ** 2 * T_point
            w_k_minus = network(k_point - h_k, T_point, t_scale) ** 2 * T_point
            w_T_plus = network(k_point, T_point + h_k, t_scale) ** 2 * (T_point + h_k)
            w_T_minus = network(k_point, T_point - h_k, t_scale) ** 2 * (T_point - h_k)
        w_k_fd = (w_k_plus - w_k_minus) / (2.0 * h_k)
        w_T_fd = (w_T_plus - w_T_minus) / (2.0 * h_k)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(w_k_auto.detach().numpy(), w_k_fd.numpy(), rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-8)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(w_T_auto.detach().numpy(), w_T_fd.numpy(), rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-8)

    def test_torch_g_matches_approach1_analytic_g(self):
        k = np.linspace(-0.14, 0.14, 29)
        model = Q1B.TorchSVI(TRUE_PARAMS)
        k_tensor = torch.tensor(k, dtype=torch.float64)
        _, _, _, g_torch = Q1B.torch_svi_g(k_tensor, model)
        _, _, _, g_analytic, _ = A1.svi_g(k, TRUE_PARAMS)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(g_torch.detach().numpy(), g_analytic, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-10)

    def test_torch_price_matches_approach1_black(self):
        DF = math.exp(-TRUE_R * TRUE_T)
        cases = [
            ("C", 1.0, 0.90, TRUE_T, DF, 0.22),
            ("C", 1.0, 1.00, TRUE_T, DF, 0.18),
            ("C", 1.0, 1.15, TRUE_T, DF, 0.31),
            ("P", 1.0, 0.85, TRUE_T, DF, 0.27),
            ("P", 1.0, 1.00, TRUE_T, DF, 0.18),
            ("P", 1.0, 1.20, TRUE_T, DF, 0.35),
            ("C", 4000.0, 3800.0, 0.08, 0.999, 0.15),
            ("P", 4000.0, 4300.0, 1.50, 0.970, 0.25),
        ]
        for cp, F, K, T, DF, sigma in cases:
            expected = A1.bs_price(cp, F, K, T, DF, sigma)
            got = float(Q1B.bs_price_torch(cp, F, K, T, DF, sigma))
            self.assertLess(abs(got - expected), 1e-10, msg=f"{cp} F={F} K={K} T={T}")

    def test_torch_svi_recovers_known_parameters(self):
        k = np.linspace(-0.25, 0.25, 81)
        w = A1.svi_w(k, TRUE_PARAMS)
        x0 = np.array([-0.010, 0.14, -0.42, -0.02, 0.13])

        self.assertLess(fit["objective"], 1e-14)
        for name, true, got in zip(("a", "b", "rho", "m", "eta"), TRUE_PARAMS, fit["params"]):
            self.assertLess(abs(got - true), 1e-5, msg=f"{name}: true={true} got={got}")
```

```
def futures_main_sina(
    symbol: str = "V0",
    start_date: str = "19900101",
    end_date: str = "22220101",
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    新浪财经-期货-主力连续日数据
    https://vip.stock.finance.sina.com.cn/quotes_service/view/qihuohangqing.html#titlePos_1
    :param symbol: 通过 ak.futures_display_main_sina() 函数获取 symbol
    :type symbol: str
    :param start_date: 开始时间
    :type start_date: str
    :param end_date: 结束时间
    :type end_date: str
    :return: 主力连续日数据
    :rtype: pandas.DataFrame
    """
    trade_date = "20210817"
    trade_date = trade_date[:4] + "_" + trade_date[4:6] + "_" + trade_date[6:]
    url = f"https://stock2.finance.sina.com.cn/futures/api/jsonp.php/var%20_{symbol}{trade_date}=/InnerFuturesNewService.getDailyKLine?symbol={symbol}&_={trade_date}"
    r = http.get(url)
    data_text = r.text
    data_json = data_text[data_text.find("([") + 1 : data_text.rfind("])") + 1]
    temp_df = pd.read_json(StringIO(data_json))
    temp_df.columns = [
        "日期",
        "开盘价",
        "最高价",
        "最低价",
        "收盘价",
        "成交量",
        "持仓量",
        "动态结算价",
    ]
    temp_df["日期"] = pd.to_datetime(temp_df["日期"], errors="coerce").dt.date
    temp_df = temp_df.set_index(keys=["日期"])
    temp_df.index = pd.to_datetime(temp_df.index)
    temp_df = temp_df[start_date:end_date]
    temp_df = temp_df.reset_index()
    temp_df["日期"] = pd.to_datetime(temp_df["日期"], errors="coerce").dt.date
    temp_df["开盘价"] = pd.to_numeric(temp_df["开盘价"], errors="coerce")
    temp_df["最高价"] = pd.to_numeric(temp_df["最高价"], errors="coerce")
    temp_df["最低价"] = pd.to_numeric(temp_df["最低价"], errors="coerce")
    temp_df["收盘价"] = pd.to_numeric(temp_df["收盘价"], errors="coerce")
    temp_df["成交量"] = pd.to_numeric(temp_df["成交量"], errors="coerce")
    temp_df["持仓量"] = pd.to_numeric(temp_df["持仓量"], errors="coerce")
    temp_df["动态结算价"] = pd.to_numeric(temp_df["动态结算价"], errors="coerce")
    return temp_df

futures_zh_daily_sina <function futures_zh_daily_sina at 0x10ef463e0>
(symbol: str = 'RB0') -> pandas.DataFrame
def futures_zh_daily_sina(symbol: str = "RB0") -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    中国各品种期货日频率数据
    https://finance.sina.com.cn/futures/quotes/V2105.shtml
    :param symbol: 可以通过 match_main_contract(symbol="cffex") 获取，或者访问网页获取
    :type symbol: str
    :return: 指定 symbol 的数据
    :rtype: pandas.DataFrame
    """
    date = "20210412"
    url = (
        "https://stock2.finance.sina.com.cn/futures/api/jsonp.php/var%20_V21052021_4_12="
        "/InnerFuturesNewService.getDailyKLine"
    )
    params = {
        "symbol": symbol,
        "type": "_".join([date[:4], date[4:6], date[6:]]),
    }
    r = http.get(url, params=params)
    temp_df = pd.DataFrame(json.loads(r.text.split("=(")[1].split(");")[0]))
    temp_df.columns = [
        "date",
        "open",
        "high",
        "low",
        "close",
        "volume",
        "hold",
        "settle",
    ]
    temp_df["open"] = pd.to_numeric(temp_df["open"], errors="coerce")
    temp_df["high"] = pd.to_numeric(temp_df["high"], errors="coerce")
    temp_df["low"] = pd.to_numeric(temp_df["low"], errors="coerce")
    temp_df["close"] = pd.to_numeric(temp_df["close"], errors="coerce")
    temp_df["volume"] = pd.to_numeric(temp_df["volume"], errors="coerce")
    temp_df["hold"] = pd.to_numeric(temp_df["hold"], errors="coerce")
    temp_df["settle"] = pd.to_numeric(temp_df["settle"], errors="coerce")
    return temp_df
```

```
# Open issues

## Q1B neural surface underperforms approach1 SVI

On the same 470 OTM quotes, the chosen neural surface (`lambda1=1.0`, `lambda2=0.01`) is clearly worse than approach1's repaired SVI:

| Model | median | p95 | max |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| approach1 repaired SVI | 0.008 | 0.055 | 0.174 |
| neural chosen | 0.044 | 0.678 | 0.982 |
| neural unpenalized `(0, 0)` | 0.053 | 0.694 | 0.998 |

The unpenalized network is also worse, so the gap is not only a penalty effect.

## Suspected cause (NOT verified)

The network may be underfitting because the option-price loss is very small (about `1e-6` scale). Adam and L-BFGS may stop at tolerances that are too loose relative to this scale. This has not been diagnosed or verified.

## Ablation confounding

The ablation is confounded because each lambda pair gets a different derived seed. Within a date, all lambda pairs should share one initialization (and differ only in lambda) to isolate the penalty effect.

## Planned diagnostic (if time allows)

- Compare the price-space loss of SVI and the network on the same quotes.
- Inspect the L-BFGS stop reasons and evaluation counts.
- Rescale the objective by a constant and check whether optimisation improves.
```

Design core function to compute per-path data and payoffs from z chunk:

```
def payoff_stats_from_z(z, S0, K, r, sigma, T, m, barrier):
    dt=T/m
    t = np.arange(1,m+1)*dt
    inc = (r-0.5*sigma**2)*dt + sigma*sqrt(dt)*z
    logS = log(S0) + np.cumsum(inc, axis=1)
    S = np.exp(logS)
    ST = S[:,-1]
    A = S.mean(axis=1)
    mx = S.max(axis=1)
    G = np.exp(logS.mean(axis=1))
    geo_call = np.maximum(G-K,0)
    asian_call = np.maximum(A-K,0)
    barrier_call = np.maximum(ST-K,0)*(mx<barrier)
    digital = (ST>K).astype(float)
    # European pathwise
    eur_pw_delta = (ST>K)*ST/S0
    eur_pw_vega = (ST>K)*ST*(np.log(ST/S0)-(r+0.5σ²)T)/sigma
    # Asian pathwise
    z_T = (np.log(ST/S0)-(r-0.5σ²)T)/(σ√T)
    asian_pw_delta = (A>K)*A/S0
    asian_pw_vega = (A>K)*(S * ((logS - log(S0) - (r+0.5σ²)*t)/σ)).mean(axis=1)
    # LR
    z1 = inc[:,0]/(σ√dt) - ((r-0.5σ²)dt)/(σ√dt)? Wait z used to generate inc; score = (ΔX - (r-σ²/2)dt)/(σ√dt) = the original z[:,0] because inc = mean + σ√dt z. So z1 = z[:,0]. Good.
    lr_delta_common = z[:,0]/(S0 σ√dt)  # for any path payoff
    # LR vega score = sum_j [(z_j² -1)/σ - √dt z_j]
    lr_vega_score = np.sum((z**2 - 1)/σ - sqrt(dt)*z, axis=1)
    # Digital LR using terminal z_T (which is (ln(ST/S0)-mean)/σ√T), equals? z_T = sum inc z_j * sqrt(dt/T)? Actually z_T = (Σ_j (mean+σ√dt z_j) - m mean)/(σ√T) = √(dt/T) Σ z_j = (1/√m)Σ z_j. Yes.
    digital_lr_delta = digital * z_T/(S0 σ√T)
    digital_lr_vega = digital * ((z_T**2-1)/σ - √T z_T)
    barrier_lr_delta = barrier_call * z[:,0]/(S0 σ√dt)
    barrier_lr_vega = barrier_call * lr_vega_score
```
